newsitem.title: UK: Barrow takes the chair at Sabre Fund Management.
newsitem.headline: Barrow takes the chair at Sabre Fund Management.

text.p: Former ED&F Man Investment Products managing director Colin Barrow has left to join Sabre Fund Management as a "significant shareholder" and chairman, a statement from Sabre said.
Barrow's role will be to broaden and develop the company's product and marketing base alongside Robin Edwards, managing director and founder of Sabre in 1982.

The futures fund management firm specialises in applying highly technical systems, especially in the field of pattern recognition, by combining technical analysis with statistical evaluation of trading opportunities.

Sabre said one of Barrow's first steps will be to establish an investor relations programme to support the trading style. Sabre's systems will then be tested to extend their application and take in international equities and bonds as well as futures.
A further projected area of development will be joint ventures and acquisitions, focusing on investment managers interested in Sabre's research facilties and sharing costs.

Barrow left ED&F Man Investment Products in March. During his time there, he was responsible for building a multi-product business that saw funds under management grow from $8.0 million to over $1.0 billion, the statement from Sabre said.
